widget.description: Complete container (layout grouping) widget definition for create or full replacement. Omitted fields are dropped on replacement. Styling lives under parameters.widgetStyle. An optional backgroundSource sets a background image asset { id, name }. Upsert defines the widget only; it neither places it nor changes existing placements.

id.description: Existing widget ID. Required when fully replacing a persisted widget; omit when creating a widget. Never invent this value. An unsaved draft widget has no ID and may be replaced by matching widget.name.

name.description: Stable widget key, e.g. "container_1". On persisted replacement, it must match the widget identified by id.

actions.description: Optional click/select interactions (navigate, run a flow, set a parameter, set a filter, record action). Full per-type shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

dynamicTokens.description: Optional dynamic value bindings keyed by token name. Full shape: _shared-widget-fields.json.

parameters.description: Container widget parameters. widgetStyle carries the container's fill, border, and background-image styling.

borderEdges.description: Which edges show a border, e.g. ["top", "bottom", "left", "right"].

alignmentX.description: Horizontal alignment of the background image.

alignmentY.description: Vertical alignment of the background image.
